source: GuardMarket builtin metadata; implementations run in a separately operated backend.
pricing_note: Example only: actual currency, mode, and per-skill prices are returned by the chosen backend. No public hosted backend is included.

skills.name: commerce.break_even
skills.title: 保本销量
skills.description: Calculate the smallest integer unit count covering fixed costs from positive unit contribution.

skills.name: commerce.cart_total
skills.title: 购物车金额汇总
skills.description: Round each line to cents, apply one order discount, tax discounted items and add untaxed shipping; caller supplies the rate.

skills.name: commerce.commission_split
skills.title: 平台与开发者分成
skills.description: Split a cent-rounded gross amount; round the platform share half-up and give the exact remainder to the developer.

skills.name: commerce.compare_offers
skills.title: 比较采购报价
skills.description: Sort named offers by unrounded unit price and then name; display rounded unit prices.

skills.name: commerce.currency_convert
skills.title: 按指定汇率换算
skills.description: Multiply a nonnegative amount by the caller's plain-decimal exchange rate; no live exchange-rate lookup.

skills.name: commerce.discount
skills.title: 折扣价格
skills.description: Round the original price to cents, then calculate a percentage discount and final price; discount rounds half-up to cents.

skills.name: commerce.margin
skills.title: 毛利与毛利率
skills.description: Calculate gross profit and gross margin as a percentage of selling price.

skills.name: commerce.markup
skills.title: 成本加成定价
skills.description: Calculate markup as a percentage of cost and return the resulting price.

skills.name: commerce.price_from_margin
skills.title: 按毛利率定价
skills.description: Compute cost / (1 - margin/100), rounding the proposed price to cents.

skills.name: commerce.price_to_increment
skills.title: 按价格步长取整
skills.description: Round a nonnegative price up to the nearest positive increment of whole cents.

skills.name: commerce.product_completeness
skills.title: 检查商品资料完整性
skills.description: Report missing, null, empty-string or empty-list fields against caller-specified required product keys.

skills.name: commerce.sku_generate
skills.title: 生成商品 SKU
skills.description: Construct a deterministic uppercase SKU from ASCII alphanumeric segments after accent removal; caller controls uniqueness.

skills.name: commerce.tax
skills.title: 价税分离
skills.description: Round the supplied amount to cents and calculate tax-exclusive or tax-inclusive amounts from the caller's rate; does not determine applicable tax rules.

skills.name: commerce.tiered_pricing
skills.title: 阶梯用量定价
skills.description: Apply graduated pricing to each tier's incremental quantity, rounding each band's cost to cents; final tier must cover quantity.

skills.name: commerce.unit_price
skills.title: 单位价格
skills.description: Divide total price by positive quantity and round to two decimals for comparison display.

skills.name: commerce.volumetric_weight
skills.title: 包裹体积重
skills.description: Calculate L×W×H/divisor from centimetre dimensions; caller supplies the carrier's divisor and actual kilograms.

skills.name: csv.escape_formulas
skills.title: 防止表格公式注入
skills.description: Prefix risky spreadsheet cells (=,+,-,@ or control/leading-whitespace variants) with an apostrophe before CSV export.

skills.name: csv.parse
skills.title: 解析 CSV 行
skills.description: Parse supplied CSV into string rows with explicit delimiter and strict quoting.

skills.name: csv.select_columns
skills.title: 选择数据表列
skills.description: Select zero-based column indices from every row; missing columns fail.

skills.name: csv.to_records
skills.title: CSV 转对象列表
skills.description: Use the first row as unique nonempty headers and require equal row widths.

skills.name: csv.transpose
skills.title: 转置数据表
skills.description: Transpose a rectangular string table; ragged rows are rejected.

skills.name: csv.write
skills.title: 生成 CSV
skills.description: Serialize string rows using RFC-style quoting and LF line endings.

skills.name: datetime.add_days
skills.title: 日期加减天数
skills.description: Add a signed number of calendar days to an ISO date.

skills.name: datetime.add_months
skills.title: 日期加减月份
skills.description: Shift calendar months and clamp the day to the destination month's final day.

skills.name: datetime.business_days
skills.title: 统计工作日
skills.description: Count Monday-Friday days in [start,end), excluding explicitly supplied holidays; no jurisdiction-specific calendar is assumed.

skills.name: datetime.convert_offset
skills.title: 转换时区偏移
skills.description: Render an aware ISO datetime at a supplied fixed UTC offset in minutes; no daylight-saving rules are inferred.

skills.name: datetime.date_parts
skills.title: 分解日期
skills.description: Return calendar fields, ISO weekday (Monday=1), ISO week/year and day of year.

skills.name: datetime.date_range
skills.title: 生成日期序列
skills.description: Generate an ascending inclusive date sequence with positive day spacing and at most 1000 dates.

skills.name: datetime.days_between
skills.title: 计算日期间隔
skills.description: Return signed end minus start in calendar days.

skills.name: datetime.from_unix
skills.title: 时间戳转日期时间
skills.description: Convert Unix seconds in the supported year range to an ISO UTC datetime.

skills.name: datetime.month_bounds
skills.title: 月份起止日期
skills.description: Return the first and last calendar dates of the supplied date's month.

skills.name: datetime.to_unix
skills.title: 日期时间转时间戳
skills.description: Convert an ISO datetime with explicit UTC offset to Unix seconds.

skills.name: encoding.base64_decode
skills.title: Base64 解码
skills.description: Strictly decode standard Base64 into UTF-8 text, rejecting binary or malformed input.

skills.name: encoding.base64_encode
skills.title: Base64 编码
skills.description: Encode UTF-8 text into standard padded Base64.

skills.name: encoding.hex_decode
skills.title: 十六进制解码
skills.description: Decode hexadecimal bytes as strict UTF-8 text; ASCII whitespace is permitted.

skills.name: encoding.hex_encode
skills.title: 十六进制编码
skills.description: Encode the UTF-8 bytes of text as lowercase hexadecimal.

skills.name: encoding.query_build
skills.title: 生成查询参数
skills.description: Build a form-encoded query string from ordered key/value pairs; spaces become +.

skills.name: encoding.query_parse
skills.title: 解析查询参数
skills.description: Parse form-style query parameters into ordered key/value pairs, preserving duplicate keys and blanks.

skills.name: encoding.sha256
skills.title: SHA256 校验和
skills.description: Compute SHA256 of supplied UTF-8 text; no file access.

skills.name: encoding.sha512
skills.title: SHA512 校验和
skills.description: Compute SHA512 of supplied UTF-8 text; no file access.

skills.name: encoding.url_decode
skills.title: URL 组件解码
skills.description: Strictly percent-decode a UTF-8 component; literal + remains +.

skills.name: encoding.url_encode
skills.title: URL 组件编码
skills.description: Percent-encode a UTF-8 URL component; spaces become %20.

skills.name: encoding.url_parse
skills.title: 解析 URL
skills.description: Split a URL into components without requesting it; invalid ports raise an input error.

skills.name: encoding.uuid_v5
skills.title: 确定性 UUID
skills.description: Generate a namespace-based UUID v5 using a supplied DNS name; unsuitable as a secret token.

skills.name: inventory.abc_classify
skills.title: ABC 库存分类
skills.description: Sort annual consumption value descending; classify by cumulative share BEFORE each item (A<80%, B<95%, else C); zero-value totals are C.

skills.name: inventory.allocate
skills.title: 按订单顺序分配库存
skills.description: Allocate a supplied stock quantity to requests in input order, reporting unfilled demand and remaining units.

skills.name: inventory.available
skills.title: 计算可售库存
skills.description: Subtract reserved and safety stock from on-hand inventory, reporting nonnegative availability and shortfall.

skills.name: inventory.days_of_cover
skills.title: 库存可用天数
skills.description: Divide available units by positive daily demand; zero demand is rejected rather than returned as infinity.

skills.name: inventory.reconcile
skills.title: 库存盘点差异
skills.description: Compare expected and counted quantities across the union of unique SKUs; missing records count as zero.

skills.name: inventory.reorder_point
skills.title: 计算补货点
skills.description: Use demand×lead time+safety stock, rounded up; compare with on-hand+on-order-reserved inventory position.

skills.name: json.diff
skills.title: 比较 JSON 数据
skills.description: Report sorted leaf-path additions, removals and changes; this is a report, not an RFC 6902 patch.

skills.name: json.flatten
skills.title: 展平 JSON
skills.description: Map each leaf or empty container to its escaped RFC 6901 path, preserving array indices.

skills.name: json.format
skills.title: 格式化 JSON
skills.description: Serialize supplied JSON with sorted keys and bounded indentation.

skills.name: json.get_pointer
skills.title: 读取 JSON 路径
skills.description: Read a value at an RFC 6901 pointer, including escaped slashes and tildes; missing paths fail.

skills.name: json.keys
skills.title: 列出对象字段
skills.description: Return sorted top-level keys from an object.

skills.name: json.merge_objects
skills.title: 合并 JSON 对象
skills.description: Shallow-merge objects in order; later values replace earlier values for the same key.

skills.name: json.omit
skills.title: 排除对象字段
skills.description: Remove requested top-level keys from a supplied object.

skills.name: json.parse
skills.title: 解析 JSON
skills.description: Parse strict JSON; reject duplicate object keys, non-finite numbers and nesting deeper than ten containers.

skills.name: json.pick
skills.title: 保留对象字段
skills.description: Return only requested keys that exist, preserving requested key order.

skills.name: json.set_pointer
skills.title: 更新 JSON 路径
skills.description: Return a copied document with a value replaced or object key inserted; parent containers must exist.

skills.name: math.clamp
skills.title: 限制数值区间
skills.description: Clamp a value between inclusive minimum and maximum, rejecting inverted intervals.

skills.name: math.combinations
skills.title: 组合数
skills.description: Compute the exact number of k-element selections from n, bounded to n ≤ 100.

skills.name: math.divmod
skills.title: 整数商和余数
skills.description: Return Python floor-division quotient and corresponding remainder; divisor zero is rejected.

skills.name: math.factorial
skills.title: 阶乘
skills.description: Compute n! for integers from 0 through 60 with a fixed arithmetic bound.

skills.name: math.gcd
skills.title: 最大公约数
skills.description: Return the nonnegative greatest common divisor of two bounded integers.

skills.name: math.interpolate
skills.title: 线性插值
skills.description: Calculate the y value along the line through two points; coincident x coordinates are rejected.

skills.name: math.lcm
skills.title: 最小公倍数
skills.description: Return the nonnegative least common multiple of two bounded integers; zero input returns zero.

skills.name: math.percentage
skills.title: 计算占比
skills.description: Return part / whole × 100; zero denominator is rejected.

skills.name: math.percentage_change
skills.title: 计算增长率
skills.description: Return (new-old)/abs(old) × 100; zero baseline is rejected.

skills.name: math.power
skills.title: 有界幂运算
skills.description: Raise a bounded base to an integer exponent from -10 to 10; reject zero negative powers and overflow.

skills.name: math.product
skills.title: 连乘
skills.description: Multiply at most 25 bounded values; empty product is 1.

skills.name: math.ratio_simplify
skills.title: 约分整数比
skills.description: Divide an integer ratio by its greatest common divisor; normalize a negative denominator.

skills.name: math.round_decimal
skills.title: 十进制四舍五入
skills.description: Round a plain decimal string using ROUND_HALF_UP and return fixed fractional digits.

skills.name: math.sqrt
skills.title: 平方根
skills.description: Return the nonnegative square root of a nonnegative finite value.

skills.name: math.sum
skills.title: 求和
skills.description: Sum a finite bounded list with compensated floating-point summation.

skills.name: statistics.histogram
skills.title: 直方分箱
skills.description: Count values in supplied increasing bins, left-inclusive/right-exclusive except the final inclusive edge.

skills.name: statistics.mean
skills.title: 算术平均数
skills.description: Compute the arithmetic mean of a nonempty finite list.

skills.name: statistics.median
skills.title: 中位数
skills.description: Return the median, averaging the middle two values for even-length input.

skills.name: statistics.minmax_normalize
skills.title: 最小最大归一化
skills.description: Scale values to [0,1] using observed minimum/maximum; a constant series becomes all zeros.

skills.name: statistics.mode
skills.title: 众数
skills.description: Return every most-frequent number sorted ascending, including ties.

skills.name: statistics.moving_average
skills.title: 移动平均
skills.description: Return complete sliding-window arithmetic means without padding.

skills.name: statistics.percentile
skills.title: 百分位数
skills.description: Compute a percentile by linear interpolation at (n-1) × p/100.

skills.name: statistics.stddev
skills.title: 标准差
skills.description: Compute population or sample standard deviation with standard Bessel correction for samples.

skills.name: statistics.variance
skills.title: 方差
skills.description: Compute population or sample variance; sample variance requires at least two observations.

skills.name: statistics.weighted_mean
skills.title: 加权平均
skills.description: Compute a weighted arithmetic mean with nonnegative weights and a positive total weight.

skills.name: text.change_case
skills.title: 变换大小写
skills.description: Apply lower, upper, title or Unicode casefold casing.

skills.name: text.character_frequency
skills.title: 统计字符频率
skills.description: Return per-character frequencies, including whitespace and Unicode characters.

skills.name: text.deduplicate_lines
skills.title: 去重文本行
skills.description: Remove duplicate lines while preserving the first occurrence and exact whitespace.

skills.name: text.html_escape
skills.title: 转义 HTML
skills.description: Escape &, angle brackets and quotes for text/attribute embedding.

skills.name: text.html_to_text
skills.title: 提取 HTML 正文
skills.description: Extract visible text from supplied HTML, suppressing script and style content; does not fetch resources.

skills.name: text.html_unescape
skills.title: 还原 HTML 实体
skills.description: Decode named and numeric HTML character references.

skills.name: text.indent
skills.title: 缩进文本
skills.description: Prefix every nonempty line with a bounded number of spaces.

skills.name: text.join
skills.title: 拼接文本
skills.description: Join supplied strings with a literal delimiter.

skills.name: text.ngrams
skills.title: 生成词组
skills.description: Generate consecutive n-word windows from whitespace-delimited words; max 500 output windows.

skills.name: text.normalize_whitespace
skills.title: 规范空白
skills.description: Collapse Unicode whitespace into single spaces and trim ends.

skills.name: text.remove_prefix_suffix
skills.title: 去除前后缀
skills.description: Remove one matching literal prefix and suffix; leave unmatched boundaries intact.

skills.name: text.replace
skills.title: 替换字面文本
skills.description: Replace literal occurrences, with a bounded maximum replacement count.

skills.name: text.slug
skills.title: 生成 URL 短名
skills.description: Remove Latin accents, lowercase, and join Unicode alphanumeric segments with hyphens.

skills.name: text.sort_lines
skills.title: 排序文本行
skills.description: Sort lines lexicographically, optionally descending.

skills.name: text.split
skills.title: 拆分文本
skills.description: Split on a nonempty literal delimiter, including empty fields.

skills.name: text.stats
skills.title: 文本统计
skills.description: Count Unicode characters, UTF-8 bytes, logical lines and non-whitespace characters.

skills.name: text.strip_accents
skills.title: 去除重音
skills.description: Remove combining marks after Unicode NFD normalization; preserves non-Latin characters.

skills.name: text.tokenize
skills.title: 提取文本词项
skills.description: Return Unicode alphanumeric tokens in original order, discarding punctuation.

skills.name: text.truncate
skills.title: 截断文本
skills.description: Limit Unicode character count, counting the suffix inside the requested limit.

skills.name: text.unicode_normalize
skills.title: 规范 Unicode
skills.description: Normalize text using one of the four standard Unicode normalization forms.

skills.name: text.word_count
skills.title: 统计词数
skills.description: Count Unicode letter/number words using fixed token boundaries.

skills.name: text.wrap
skills.title: 文本折行
skills.description: Wrap paragraphs to a bounded width using standard whitespace wrapping.

skills.name: units.area
skills.title: 面积单位换算
skills.description: Convert area using explicit base-unit factors; numeric result uses IEEE floating-point.

skills.name: units.duration
skills.title: 时长单位换算
skills.description: Convert duration using explicit base-unit factors; numeric result uses IEEE floating-point.

skills.name: units.length
skills.title: 长度单位换算
skills.description: Convert length using explicit base-unit factors; numeric result uses IEEE floating-point.

skills.name: units.mass
skills.title: 质量单位换算
skills.description: Convert mass using explicit base-unit factors; numeric result uses IEEE floating-point.

skills.name: units.speed
skills.title: 速度单位换算
skills.description: Convert speed using explicit base-unit factors; numeric result uses IEEE floating-point.

skills.name: units.storage
skills.title: 数字存储容量单位换算
skills.description: Convert storage using explicit base-unit factors; numeric result uses IEEE floating-point.

skills.name: units.temperature
skills.title: 温度单位换算
skills.description: Convert Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin; reject temperatures below absolute zero.

skills.name: units.volume
skills.title: 体积单位换算
skills.description: Convert volume using explicit base-unit factors; numeric result uses IEEE floating-point.

skills.name: validation.duplicates
skills.title: 查找重复数据
skills.description: Report repeated JSON values and counts in first-appearance order, with object keys compared order-independently.

skills.name: validation.ean13
skills.title: EAN-13 条码校验
skills.description: Validate exactly 13 ASCII digits and the EAN-13 check digit; does not confirm product registration.

skills.name: validation.email
skills.title: 检查邮箱语法
skills.description: Validate common unquoted ASCII email syntax and domain labels; does not establish mailbox existence.

skills.name: validation.http_url
skills.title: 检查 HTTP URL
skills.description: Check basic http/https URL structure, hostname presence, port and absence of credentials/control/whitespace; not an SSRF policy.

skills.name: validation.ip_address
skills.title: 检查 IP 地址
skills.description: Validate a literal IPv4 or IPv6 address of the requested version without DNS lookup.

skills.name: validation.iso_date
skills.title: 检查日期有效性
skills.description: Check exact YYYY-MM-DD syntax and actual Gregorian calendar validity.

skills.name: validation.luhn
skills.title: Luhn 校验
skills.description: Check a supplied 2–32 digit identifier with the Luhn checksum; does not validate an account or authorize a payment.

skills.name: validation.numeric_range
skills.title: 检查数值区间
skills.description: Return zero-based indices and values outside a caller-supplied inclusive interval; inverted bounds are rejected.

skills.name: validation.required_fields
skills.title: 检查记录必填字段
skills.description: Report 1-based rows missing required keys or containing null/empty-string values; zero and false remain valid.

skills.name: validation.uuid
skills.title: 检查 UUID
skills.description: Validate canonical hyphenated UUID syntax, case-insensitively; does not require a particular UUID version.
